authored_narrative.episode_purpose: Fifteen real episodes on, this Story's two oldest motifs — a spirit's departure, a familiar loneliness that no longer lands — appear together once more, both fully retired from carrying any weight, which is itself the entire content of the episode.

scene_spirited_away_river_spirit_departu.purpose: A spirit departs; Gonagi notices without needing to act on the noticing. The ethical test this anchor once posed in Episode 1 has been fully answered by every episode since — this one just confirms the answer held.
scene_spirited_away_river_spirit_departu.stakes: whether an anchor can appear a fifth time without needing new meaning
scene_spirited_away_river_spirit_departu.opposing_force: none — the anchor is allowed to simply recur

scene_spirited_away_no_face_loneliness_0.purpose: The loneliness-shaped space registers as nothing at all — not even the flattened non-event it was in Episode 11, just absent from the emotional register entirely.

shot_spirited_00593.intent: A distant observational frame, the fourth real treatment of this specific composition family, unchanged.

shot_spirited_00601.intent: A plain medium shot with no isolation-coded framing at all.
